Commentary.Commentary: Nathan Lyon was too hot to handle for Bangladesh. He finished with seven wickets and utilized the conditions quite well. Ashton Agar also picked up a couple while the other bowlers were decent. Let's see how Australia respond with the bat now. There are still a few overs left before lunch. Stay tuned...

Bangladesh have successfully managed to post a score in excess of 300! After opting to bat yesterday, they lost early wickets and were struggling at one stage. Nathan Lyon was the chief tormentor, claiming the top four batsmen, all via lbw. But after that, Mushfiqur Rahim constructed a century partnership along with Sabbir Rahman to bring the home side back on track. Nasir Hossain also played a vital knock towards the end which helped the Bangla Tigers achieve a good first innings total.

PITCH REPORT -  Ed Rainsford says the pitch is quite dusty. He reckons days two and three are going to be the best day for batting. He opines it is not going to be easy to score.

Switching back to cricket! The hosts after suffering early blows yesterday, bounced back courtesy the partnership between Rahman and Rahim. They find themselves in a good position, although they still will hope to get past the 300-run mark to gain the psychological advantage. The visitors on the other hand, will try and bundle their opposition out as quickly as possible. A lot will depend on Nathan Lyon as he was their best bowler yesterday. We are in for an exciting day of cricket. Stay tuned.

Let's start the day with not-so-good-news. On the route back to the hotel last night a window on the Australian team bus was broken. No one was injured in the incident. The Bangladeshi authorities are taking it seriously and are investigating the cause. The security has been boosted since then.
Day 2, first session...

Nathan Lyon was the hero for the visitors. He started off the day superbly and then came back to break the vital century stand as well. With that, he completed his fifer as well. Ashton Agar was the only one to pick another. Pat Cummins looked threatening early on but then lost his steam as the day progressed. Steve O'Keefe and Hilton Cartwright were very ordinary today. The Kangaroos will now look to come afresh tomorrow and bowl out the home side in a hurry. The hosts on the other hand will want the current pair to keeping piling up runs. Join us tomorrow at 1000 local (0400 GMT) for all the action of Day 2!

Bangladesh will be happier of the two sides heading into the dressing room. The aggression of Sabbir Rahman mixed with the caution of Mushfiqur Rahim, has helped the hosts to get the momentum. Both went on to score their respective fifties and  stitched a 105-run stand for the 6th wicket. Rahman then lost his balance and wicket as well. However, his wicket didn't do much damage as the skipper found an able partner in Nasir Hossain. Both these batsmen then scored boundaries at regular intervals and are amidst a healthy partnership.

OUT! That's the verdict from upstairs! Another fifer for Nathan Lyon! Short and spinning down leg, Rahman goes for the pull but in the process loses his balance. Wade collects the ball and seeing Sabbir's leg up in the air, takes the bails off. He is confident and starts celebrating. The umpire refers it upstairs. It's a tough one for the third umpire as one angle shows the boot to be on the line while the other shows some part of the boot to be inside. It's very confusing and after looking at it for a long time, the TV umpire gives the benefit of doubt to the fielding side. Sabbir Rahman has to depart after a superb counter-attacking knock. That's the end of the 105-run stand as well. A much-needed breakthrough for the Aussies.

Time for a burst by Hilton Cartwright.
Floats it around off, Rahim defends it.
Angles it on middle, turned towards mid on for a single.

Fuller on middle, driven to long off for a single.

Fuller outside off, Rahman drives it over mid off. Cummins goes to his left and slides to stop the ball. Two runs taken. The umpire is not sure and hence refers it upstairs. Replays show that Pat was fine and hence no boundary signaled.

Shorter around off, Rahman shapes to cut but finds the point fielder.

Rahman pushes one through covers for a single.

Pat Cummins back on the field.
Arm ball on middle and leg, Rahim blocks it out.
Shorter around off, Rahim defends it watchfully.
Flatter around off, Rahim defends it from his crease.
Short and wide outside off, cut towards point by the batsman.

4th Test fifty for Sabbir Rahman!
Full toss on the pads, turned through square leg for a couple of runs. Sabbir Rahman has played really well and must carry on.
Rahman turns it towards the leg side from his crease.
Looks to drive it through but finds short extra cover. The throw comes in at the keeper's end who cannot collect it and a couple of runs result. Maxwell was the fielder, again.
Floats it around middle, Rahman comes forward and blocks it.
Time for Steve O'Keefe!
Arm ball on middle, Rahim keeps it out.
Mushfiqur stays in line and defends it.
Floats it outside off, Rahim comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Lands it outside off, Rahim looks to sweep it. He gets a top edge. The deep backward square leg fielder goes to his left but cannot reach it. Two runs taken. Surprising shot from Rahim.
Rahim lunges forward and keeps this one out.
Fuller around off, Rahim comes forward and blocks it.
FOUR! Top shot! Floats it outside off, Rahman gets down on it and sweeps it  through mid-wicket for a boundary. That was superbly hit by Sabbir.
Floats it around off, Rahman comes forward and blocks it. Smith was going across expecting a paddle there.
Fuller outside off, Rahim gets outside the line and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter around off, Rahim works it towards short leg from his crease.
Rahman gets low and paddle sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Lands it outside off, Sabbir waits for it and dabs it down towards third man. Warner hares after it but good running fetches them a couple of runs.

Slows it up around off, Sabbir comes forward and blocks it.
Drives it towards the left of the bowler who dives to his left and stops it.
Remains in his crease and blocks this one.

FOUR! Just over! Floats it outside off, Sabbir Rahman comes down and goes through with his inside out shot over covers. Manages to get it just over the fielder and collects a boundary. High risk, high rewards. Replays show the bat turned in his hands there.
Floats it outside off, Rahim comes down and blocks it.
Similar line and length, this time Rahim works it to the right of the short leg fielder.
Flatter on middle, tucked towards short leg by Rahim.
Floats it outside off, Rahman drives it towards mid off for a single. That was a bit wide for that shot.
A tad short around off, punched into covers.
Shorter around off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller around off and middle, turned towards the leg side.
50-run stand is up between Mushfiqur Rahim and Sabbir Rahman! First one of the match.
Shorter around off, punched into covers for a single. Brings up the 50-run stand!
Shorter outside off, Rahim stays back and angles it towards point from his crease.
Comes down and pushes it through mid off for a single.
Flatter on middle and leg, flicked towards fine leg for a brace.
Fuller around off, Rahman comes forward and blocks it.
Fuller on middle and leg, whipped towards mid-wicket by Rahim.
Flatter around off, Rahim decides very late that he needs to keep it out and brings his bat down in a hurry. Needed to be on the front foot there.
Full and outside off, Rahim comes forward and pushes it to cover.
Lands it outside off, swept towards the deep mid-wicket fence. Good fielding in the deep, two runs taken.
Flatter outside off, Rahim goes back and punches it towards covers.
Floats it around middle, Rahim nudges it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Nathan Lyon to bowl from the other end. Pat Cummins has not come on the field after the break.
Edged! Agar fires it outside off, Rahman shapes to defend but gets an outside edge. The ball runs past first slip and Warner hares after it from backward point and keeps them down to a brace.
Flatter around off, Rahman punches it towards covers.
FOUR! Top shot! Rahman slinks down the wicket and clatters one over the head of the mid on fielder for a boundary. That was hit very cleanly.

Is that Out? No. Floats it around middle, Rahman comes down and looks to defend it. The keeper appeals long and hard. The bowler is not sure which puts off Smith, who was eager on it. Replays show that there was an inside edge. Good call, that.
Flatter on middle, Rahman defends it back to the bowler.
Lands it around middle, Rahman looks to defend but gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket.
Players are back out for play! Sabbir Rahman and Mushfiqur Rahim stride out to bat. Australia begin with Ashton Agar. Here we go...
Day 1, Session 3!

The home side will hope that Rahim bats well with the lower middle order as any total in excess of 300 should be a good one on this wicket. They though need to mind their shots since there have been quite a few soft dismissals. Let's see how they bat in the final session of play. Join us in a while for it.

A fighting session of Test cricket! Bangladesh stitched in a good stand with Shakib and Rahim before Agar struck to send back the southpaw. Australia would have hoped for a collapse but the pair of Rahim and Rahman has ensured there wasn't any and built a small little stand. The bowling has been good but there is little spin on offer. The tourists will want to take wickets at regular intervals to keep the Tigers in check.
Fuller on middle, Rahim clips it towards mid on from his crease. That's Tea, Day 1!

Angles it on middle and leg, turned towards one of the short mid-wicket fielders. The fielder returns a wild throw at the batsman. Rahim is not impressed. Maxwell was the fielder there. Might have booked his place for a meet with the ICC referee.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a boundary. Two boundaries in the over already!
Very full on middle, Rahim jams it out towards mid on from his crease.
Drifts it into the pads, turned through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Poor ball! Starts with a full toss outside off, Rahman just places it in the gap at covers and gets a boundary. Superb timing, on that occasion.
Hilton Cartwright comes on for a bowl. Two mid-wickets in place. Can he strike before Tea?
That kept a touch low! Good length outside off, keeps a tad low, Rahim does well to counter it and keep it out.
Good length outside off, comes in, Rahim gets in line and defends it.
Cartwright is warming up!
Pitches it up around off, Rahim gets it towards mid off with a push. Well bowled.
Rahim pushes this one to covers from his crease.
Good length outside off, left alone by Rahim.
Angling into the batsman, Rahim turns it towards the fielder at square leg.
Flatter around off, Sabbir punches it off his crease towards the off side.

Sabbir comes down, Agar spots that and fires it outside off. Rahman comes forward and defends it at the last moment.
Arm ball around off and middle, Sabbir defends it.
Fires it down the leg side, Rahman fails to connect with his sweep shot. The ball dies down after hitting Wade.
Floats it around middle, Rahman comes forward and blocks it.
Good length around off, Rahim defends it watchfully.

Fuller in length, Rahman looks to go big over the leg side but does not hit it well. The ball does not carry to the fielder in the deep at square leg. Agar goes to his left from backward square leg but cannot get to it. A single taken.
Good length around off, Rahman defends it from his crease.
Fuller around off, turned through square leg for a single.
Almost a yorker in line of the stumps, Mushfiqur Rahim keeps it out.
Angles it around off and middle, Rahim defends it from his crease.
Nudges one through the backward square leg region for a single.
Shorter outside off, bounces more, Rahim keeps it down towards the point region.
Flatter down the leg side, Rahim fails to clip it through and is hit on his pads. A loud appeal is turned down.
Arm ball on middle, Rahim keeps it out from his crease.
Fuller outside off, Rahim drives it to the left of the bowler who stops it going to his right side.
Turned through square leg for a couple of runs.
Ashton Agar returns for a bowl.
Good length outside off, Rahman plays a nice punch-drive through covers for a couple of runs.
Good length around off, turned towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Yorker around off, Rahman digs it out from his crease. Well bowled, that.
Full again, Sabbir plays another good looking drive towards mid off. He has been positive so far but needs to ensure there are no rash shots.
Fuller outside off, driven towards mid off by the batsman. That was hit really well.
Good length outside off, Rahman defends it from his crease.
Pat Cummins comes back on for a burst.
Flatter outside off, played to point by the batsman.
Gets in line and blocks it from his crease.
Shorter outside off, Rahim goes back and angles it towards third man for a couple of runs. These two are going along well with Sabbir being the aggressor.
Flatter around off, kept out by Rahim.
Cheeky! Floats it around off, Rahman gets across and paddles it towards fine leg for a single.
Floats it outside off, Rahman comes foward and pushes it towards the off side.
Mushfiqur gets in line and blocks it.
Flatter around off, played back to the bowler.
Lands it outside off, Rahim comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Stays back and turns it towards the leg side.
Flatter around off, Rahim looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Fuller outside off, Rahman comes forward and pushes it towards long off for a single.
Floats it outside off, Rahim comes forward and keeps it out.
Rahim prods forward and blocks it carefully.
Fuller outside off, pushed to covers by Rahim.
Fuller around off, whipped to mid on by Rahim.
Floats it around off, swept to deep backward square leg for a single.

SIX! Just over the fence! Lyon bowls it around off and middle, Rahman comes down to have a go at it. The ball goes off the toe end of the bat. Cartwright at long on looks to take it but the ball flies over him and into the fence. Risk pays off for Sabbir.
Slides one down the leg side, Rahim looks to clip it through but misses. Wade fumbles too behind the wickets.

In the air..........safe! Lyon bowls it outside off, Rahman goes for the sweep. He gets a top edge on this one. Renshaw in the deep at backward square leg does not pick it well and cannot get to it. A run taken.

OUT! The move works! Agar bowls it a touch flat outside off, skids on, Shakib goes back to force it through the off side but gets an outside edge. Wade takes the catch and celebrates taking a good one. The stand is broken and Australia remain on top of the game. Shakib walks back to the hut livid with himself. Bangladesh in trouble.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Shakib goes back and crunches it through point for a boundary. They have been patient to wait for the bad ball.

Fires the arm ball on middle, Shakib aims to cut but the ball gets big on him. Manages to keep it out though.

Floated outside off, Mominul comes forward and square drives it through the point region for a brace. Confident shot, that.
Drifts it into the pads, worked towards backward square leg off the crease by Haque.

First run in 19 deliveries! Haque prods forward and pushes it into covers for a single.

Pat Cummins to bowl from the other end.
Flatter on middle and leg, Shakib looks to defend but gets an inside edge towards the leg side. A wicket maiden for Lyon.

Welcome back, folks! The men concerned are making their way out in the centre. Shakib Al Hasan has joined Mominul Haque. Nathan Lyon to complete his over. Here we go...
Day 1, second session...

Bangladesh were in a similar situation in the first Test match as well and the experience of Tamim and Shakib bailed them out. This time they will be relying on their middle order to do the job. Can they stand up and deliver? It's not going to be easy against Lyon and Co. Promises to be an exciting afternoon session. Do join us in a short while.

Terrific session for Australia after losing the toss! All the three top order batsmen for Bangladesh were trapped in front by Nathan Lyon who bowled splendidly with the new cherry. Pat Cummins also breathed fire in his two spells but wasn't successful in picking any wicket (Tamim was dropped by Maxwell off his bowling). The other two spin bowlers, O'Keefe and Agar also supported well and were at the batsmen every ball. The pitch has not offered too much turn but the lines from the Australian spinners have been immaculate.

OUT! LBW! Lyon strikes at the stroke of lunch! He is pumped up and the Australians will be the happier of the two teams going into the break. Not exactly the slider, but it was delivered at a good pace, around 95.6 kph. It landed around middle and leg and Sarkar played forward for the turn. However, the ball went past his inside edge, clipped the front pad and then hit his back pad. The Aussies appealed and up went Nigel Llong's finger. Sarkar and Mominul contemplated a lot with but eventually decided against the review. The former wanted a second opinion but Mominul was defiant and sent him on his way. Hawk Eye shows the ball to be skidding on and clipping the leg stump. Had the review been taken by Sarkar, he would have still been out because the umpire's call would have stayed. That will be LUNCH ON DAY 1!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short and outside off, punched wide of the bowler.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Appeal for a catch, turned down. The Aussies are confident but decide against the review. Nothing in it basically, MH looked to tuck it away but the ball went off the hips to short leg.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

HOW CLOSE WAS THAT? Very, very close. Mominul has to thank his stars. A wicket almost at the stroke of lunch. Landed around off, Mominul went back to flick it to the leg side but the ball came on slowly, took the inside edge and went right between his legs. However, it then dropped down and rolled back perilously towards the leg stump. Mominul had no idea and looked to kick it away years later while Wade was watching the cherry, hoping that it will hit the timber. It just rolled past the leg stump.
Around middle and leg, flicked towards backward square leg.

A chat now between Steven Smith and Ashton Agar. The former is suggesting something but the latter is shaking his head. Eventually, nothing changes. Oh wait, something does change. Warner comes in from backward point towards leg slip.
Similar line and length, blocked solidly.

Fires a quicker one outside off, a touch short in length, Mominul defends it from the back foot.

Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Lunges this time, to a full ball and defends it to the leg side.

The mid on fielder runs forward to gather the ball on one bounce. The Australian fielders thought that it came off the top edge and were excited momentarily.

Leans forward to a full ball and offers a dead bat in defense.
Flighted and full on off, defended off the front foot.
Arm ball outside off, short in length, it's cut through point for a couple of runs.
Skidding away from the batsman, Haque pushes at it in defense but is beaten. Wade is quick to dislodge the bails but Mominul was safely in.

Edged and just safe! O'Keefe is a bit on the shorter side outside off, skidding away from the batsman, a late thought to play at it by Mominul but it takes the outside half of the blade. It flies past the diving first slip fielder and they take a couple of runs. 50 up for Bangladesh.
Pitches it full and outside off, Mominul plays a nice looking drive past the diving cover fielder. A single taken.
Fuller and on off, solidly defended back to the bowler.

Well done, Wade! Sliding down the leg side, on a length, Mominul fails to flick and it goes off his thigh pad towards the keeper. Wade flies to his right to make an excellent stop. Saves four for his side.
A shade short in length and in the channel outside off, Haque is watchful as he lets it through to the keeper.
On a length and in the line of the stumps, Mominul gets behind the line and blocks it to the off side.

Lands it on a fuller length outside off, Sarkar drives it down the ground, not from the middle of the bat but it goes in the gap. The mid off fielder cuts it off and they pinch a single in the meantime.

FOUR! Again it's uppish but away from the reach of the fielder. Mominul is living dangerously. He jumps out of the crease to whip it across the line but ends up dragging it from the inside half of the bat. It goes aerially but safely over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Very full and on off, driven firmly to mid off.
A little bit of inward spin there from around off, Mominul tries playing straight but it takes the inside edge and rolls towards the leg side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and on middle, eased down through mid on for a single.
Mid on drops back.
Too full in length outside off, it's driven off the front foot by Mominul. Wide of the mid off fielder and an easy run is taken.
Change of ends for Steve O'Keefe.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, from over the wicket, Sarkar punches it from the back foot to covers where the fielder dives to take some pace off the ball. A couple of runs taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fetches a short ball from outside off and swivels inside the crease with his pull shot. Middles quite well but finds the square leg fielder.
Angles in a length ball on off, Sarkar offers a straight bat in defense.
Uppish but safe! No conviction in that shot at all. Cummins angles it into the batsman, Sarkar plays a loose flick shot in the air but it goes safely through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Starts his second spell from around the wicket and bowls a length ball outside off. Sarkar defends it watchfully from the back foot.
Pat Cummins is brought back into the attack.
Continues to bowl flat and quick, around off, Haque lunges and defends.
Quicker again, 94 kph, Mominul does well to keep it out safely.
Short again, on off, cut straight to point.
Fires a flatter and shorter ball on off, it's punched from the back foot to covers.
Full and around leg, swept through backward square leg for a single.
Short in length and skidding into the batsman, Sarkar fails to pull and is hit on the thigh pad.
Clips a full ball fine down the leg side for a run.
Flighted and on off, Mominul plays a full-blooded sweep shot and it ricocheted off the body of the backward short leg fielder. The ball ran behind him and they took a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Knocks it down in the wide mid on region for a single.
Full and flat on middle, swept through backward square leg for a run.
Mominul has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
SIX! Great use of the feet by Sarkar. He immediately dances down to the pitch of the delivery and launches it over long on for a biggie. Attack is the best form of defense.
Sliding down the leg side, worked off the pads towards short leg.
Spinning away from the batsman, Sarkar throws his bat at it and slices it towards point.
Flatter and on off, defended off the back foot.
FOUR! A flighted full ball outside off, Sarkar presses forward and creams his drive through covers for a glorious boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Helps it behind square leg and takes a single.
Goes down with the sweep shot, makes good connection also but it finds the short leg fielder again. Hits Handscomb on the shin.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Straightaway Sarkar is down the track to a full ball and hits it across the line to mid-wicket.

Shout for a catch! Great piece of wicketkeeping by Wade! Flatter ball outside off, short in length and keeping very low. Sarkar tries to cut but fails to middle it. There is some noise as it goes through to the keeper. Wade does well to snap it and appeals. Nothing from the umpire, maybe bat hitting the turf. In fact, the replays confirm the same. There was a little bit of thought given for the usage of DRS but Wade wasn't sure. Good call.
Walks down the track and works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Fires one in on off, Mominul draws forward in defense but it takes the inside edge and rolls past short leg to square leg. Another successful over for Lyon!
Flatter and shorter outside off, Mominul gets on the back foot and defends it from the bottom half of the bat.
Mominul Haque is the new batsman.

Drinks break. Excellent start for the visiting side. They have already picked up a couple of wickets and with the pitch assisting spin, they would like to take more wickets before lunch. Bangladesh, on the contrary, would be hoping for partnerships.

OUT! A successful review by Australia. Lyon serves a full flighted ball on off, skidding into the batsman, Kayes tries to sweep across the line but misses and is rapped on the pads. They appeal vociferously but the umpire shows no interest. Nathan Lyon thought maybe there were two noises but Matthew Wade convinces Steven Smith to take the referral. The Ultra Edge detects no bat and the Hawk Eye confirms it to be hitting the stumps. Impact was never an issue. Bangladesh two down in the first hour!
Appeal for an lbw. Not given and Steven Smith opts for the review.
Slower through the air, full and on middle, Kayes rather than getting forward, defends it from the back foot.
Quicker, flatter and shorter on middle, Kayes hits it across the line towards mid-wicket.
Flatter on the pads, Sarkar gets back and works it through backward square leg for a run.
Skips down the track and tries to whip it across the line. It takes the inner half of the bat and squirts past short leg for a single.
Shortish and on middle, tapped down in front of short leg.
Slower through the air, full and on off, defended off the front foot.
Full and flighted down the leg side, Sarkar tries to sweep but fails to middle it. Goes off his gloves behind towards first slip.
Skidding away from the batsman, Kayes pushes inside the line and edges it wide of point for a single.
Flatter and around off, Kayes defends it from the back foot.
Two men close-in on the leg side. A forward short leg and a backward short leg.
Again it's bowled quicker through the air outside off, 91.5 kph, a touch short, Sarkar chops it down to backward point.
Quicker and fuller on middle, 90.5 kph, dug out back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Stays on the back foot and blocks it towards short leg.
Flatter and on middle, defended from the back foot to the leg side. Once again Handscomb is swift to move across to his right from short leg to stop the ball.
Floated and on middle, Sarkar gets forward and defends it with gentle hands. It comes off the inside edge and runs wide of short leg. No run taken as Handscomb quickly gets to the ball.
Loopy and on middle, Sarkar plays it out off the inside edge and it sneaks past the left side of the short leg fielder. They cross for a hesitant single.
Slower this time, full and on middle, 81.5 kph, it's defended off the front foot.
Gets on the front foot and defends it watchfully.
Fires one on the pads, Sarkar defends it down to short leg.
Flighted and on middle, flicked aerially but wide of short leg. Late in reacting, the close-in fielder.
Drifting down the leg side, turned through square leg for a single.
Steve O'Keefe time!
Remains on the back foot and plays it down to covers. End of a successful over.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.

Short delivery outside off, some extra bounce as Imrul commits himself into the pull shot. Fails to middle his shot but luckily for him it goes wide of mid-wicket. A couple of runs to get off the mark. All the batsmen have got off the mark in an unconvincing way.
Turning away from the batsman, Kayes defends it down with an angled bat to point.
Flighted ball around off, defended off the front foot by the new batsman.
Imrul Kayes walks in next at number 3.

OUT! Tamim trapped in front of the wickets! That dropped catch has not cost Australia much. Lyon dishes out a slider around off, skidding through the surface and thudding Tamim on the pads who was late in bringing his bat down. In fact, the replays show that his bat got a bit stuck behind the pads which prevented him from getting to the ball. It has hit him very adjacent to the wickets, they appeal and the finger goes up almost immediately. A very good breakthrough for the tourists.
Beaten! Movement off the deck from a shortish length around off, Sarkar has to play at it but is beaten. In hindsight, he could have left it alone and trusted the bounce. Top bowling by Pat!
Strays on the pads, it's eased away through backward square leg for a single.
Sharp delivery, landing outside off and zipping away, Tamim allows it through to the keeper.
A wild shot attempted by Tamim! He loves playing his shots but should look to be careful early in his innings. Cummins hurls across a short and wide delivery outside off, Iqbal flashes and misses.
Puts it just outside off, Iqbal is on the front foot as he blocks it to mid off.
Good length delivery on middle, Tamim tries to tap and run but the cover fielder is quick to the ball and he has to abort the plan.
Flatter and a touch shorter again, around off, Sarkar punches it from the back foot to covers. Another maiden for Nathan Lyon.
Goes slower through the air but the length is on the shorter side, Sarkar immediately gets back and plays the square cut. Finds the cover-point fielder.
Probably a slider, around off, blocked back from the inner half of the bat.
Quicker this time, full and on middle, defended back to the bowler.
Slower through the air, full and just outside off, Sarkar draws forward and defends it towards point.
Flighted and full on off, defended to short leg.
A bumper on middle, Tamim is in no mood to take the challenge of pulling it. A dropped catch in the over. Australia will be disappointed.
On a length around off, moving away a touch, Tamim gets on the front foot and taps it down to gully.
A little short in length around middle, Tamim quietly glances it through backward square leg and takes a couple of runs.
Sharp bouncer, around middle, Tamim immediately ducks underneath it.
Straighter in line, worked on the leg side, not in the gap.

Dropped by Maxwell! That's a sitter. Back of a length delivery around middle, shaping away a touch, Tamim has a tame push inside the line and gets a fat outside edge to Maxwell at third slip. He spills a fairly straightforward catch. You don't want to drop Tamim. A costly miss.
Floated and on off, Soumya presses forward and defends it from the upper half of the bat. A maiden!
Watchfully defended off the front foot by Sarkar. Not looking too bothered.
Loopy and around off, Sarkar once again takes his front leg forward and defends it watchfully.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter and on off, Sarkar gets back to defend and does so from the inner half of the bat.
Shortish and on off, Sarkar shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Keeps probing in the zone outside off, Tamim looks to play at it initially but then allows it through. Although it looked like a play and a miss. Probing stuff.
Angling away from the batsman, once again Tamim feels for it and is beaten.
Play and a miss. A zippy delivery, on a shortish length in the channel around off, Tamim pokes at it and gets beaten. This is excellent bowling by Pat!
Full in length on this occasion, Tamim works it off his pads to square leg.

Appeal for a catch, nothing from the umpire. Cummins surprises the batsman with a well-cooked short delivery. It's targeted at him, Tamim takes his eyes off as he tries to duck. The ball balloons in the air from his body and Maxwell runs forward from third slip to collect the catch. They appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. The replays show that it came off Tamim's shoulders.
Fuller in length outside off, Tamim draws forward and drives it towards mid off.
A touch short and angling into the batsman, Iqbal goes on the back foot and hits it through square leg for a single.
Stifled appeal for an lbw. Tamim once again dances down the track to smother the spin but fails to put bat to ball. Gets rapped on the pads, they appeal but he seems too much down the pitch.
Tossed up ball outside off, Tamim leans forward and tries to defend it with a straight bat. But it grabs the outside edge and runs past backward point. A couple of runs taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Walks down the track to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Lucky that he had his second line of defense in place.
Flighted ball on middle, skidding in, Tamim gets forward to defend, goes with firm hands and it takes the inside edge. Hurries through the vacant leg slip region for a couple of runs.
Shortish in length again, defended from the back foot towards point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, shaping away a touch, Sarkar pokes at it away from his body and is beaten.

Full in length and around middle and off, Tamim gets forward and tries pushing it on the leg side. But it takes the leading edge and rolls in the gap at extra cover for a single. He is off the mark and like his partner in a streaky way.
Slants a length ball outside off, Iqbal keeps his bat close to himself and allows it through to the keeper.
On a good length in the zone outside off, Tamim shoulders arms to let it through.
Some issues near the sightscreen. Tamim pulls out as Cummins was in his delivery stride. Umpire Ian Gould is getting things fixed. Taking more time than it should.
Angling away from the batsman, outside off, Tamim pushes inside the line and misses.
Shortish, quicker and around middle and off, Sarkar gets back inside the crease and blocks. Testing over!

FOUR! Bangladesh are away in a streaky fashion! Spinning away from the batsman from a shortish length, Sarkar gets back to cut it through the line but it takes a thickish inside edge and runs through Wade to the fence. He was late in reacting.

Appeal for an lbw, turned down. Probably an arm ball landing around middle, skidding down and beats the defensive shot offered by Sarkar. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal but the umpire disagrees.
This one skids back into the batsman from around off, Sarkar lunges in defense and gets it away from the inside half of the bat.
Floated and fuller on off, Sarkar gets on the front foot and defends it.
Flighted off spinner outside off, some extra bounce but very little spin, Sarkar allows it through to the keeper.
Interestingly, Nathan Lyon to share the new cherry from the other end. First time since 1938, Australia are beginning with a spinner in the first innings of a Test match.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Tamim chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

Edged but safe! Cummins aims for the yorker, not in the line of the stumps, it's outside off and Tamim brings his bat down to dig it out. It takes the outside edge and runs behind. A good diving stop by Maxwell at third slip.
Hurls it on a length and in the channel outside off, a comfortable leave for Iqbal.
This time the line is too straight as Cummins tries to repeat the last delivery. Not much movement and Tamim works it off his pads to square leg.
Beauty of a delivery! Cummins lands it on a length just outside off and gets it to move away a little. Tamim feels for it, not much footwork, and gets beaten. Not far from edging it.
Starts with a gentle loosener, full and way wide outside off, Tamim has an easy leave.

It's time to get underway! The Australian team is taking the field. Tamim Iqbal and Soumya Sarkar are expected openers for Bangladesh. Pat Cummins, the only speedster, in the Aussies line-up will begin proceedings (I know Hilton Cartwright also bowls seam up, but he ain't a speedster). Three slips in place. Here we go...

Pitch report - The deck is a lot lighter in colour than it was in Dhaka. Won't crumble much like the last match. Once you get in, start making as many runs as possible, as it will deteoriate with time..

Toss - Up goes the coin. Steven Smith once again calls it incorrectly and Mushfiqur Rahim has no hesitation in saying - BANGLADESH WILL BAT! They have made a single change, strengthening their batting by bringing in Mominul Haque in place of Shafiul Islam. Australia have a couple of changes. Usman Khawaja and Josh Hazlewood make way for Hilton Cartwright and Steve O'Keefe.

A golden opportunity of a Test series win over Australia will keep the home side going. At this point of time, they are looking a better-balanced team than the Kangaroos. The tourists although are certain to make some changes, given the injury to Josh Hazlewood and ordinary form of Matthew Wade and Usman Khawaja. Stay with us for all the updates...

Yet another spin test awaits the Aussies! After surrendering rather meekly towards the end of the first Test match, the visitors will be hurt. They had the chase going well till the time Warner and Smith were in the middle but as soon as they left, Australia crumbled like cookies. Many felt it was an upset victory but if you have followed Bangladesh's rise in the past one year, you will know it was well-planned and well-deserved.

Forecast for the second Test match in Chittagong is not promising for all five days but here we are starting on a bright note. The SUN IS OUT in its full glory and as of now, there will be no delay. On that positive update, let me welcome you all to the coverage.
